time_scope: Dixon 1981 corpus as modeled by Hayes & Wilson
claim: The 57 Appendix-D constraints are explicitly evidentially heterogeneous: 28 are unviolated in the training data and 29 are violated only a few times/reflect underrepresentation, but the published Appendix-D table does not identify which individual constraints belong to which group. Therefore individual model constraints must not be upgraded to exceptionless grammatical restrictions solely from the Appendix-D list.
formal_environment: meta-level evidence status for Appendix D constraints
normalized_environment: APPENDIX_D item status = UNKNOWN_PER_ITEM; aggregate partition 28 ZERO_VIOLATION + 29 SPARSE_VIOLATION
exceptions_or_counterexamples: The authors allow two interpretations: some constraints could be valid speaker knowledge, or the learner may have overfit accidentally true generalizations; no Wargamay-speaker experiment resolves this for these items.

time_scope: Dixon 1981 corpus as modeled by Hayes & Wilson
claim: A simple early-stopping solution to overfit would also risk discarding genuine phonotactics: Hayes & Wilson report that the last nonredundant constraint corresponding to Dixon's analysis was discovered 56th. They therefore suggest complexity/MDL-style pruning rather than assuming that all late-learned constraints are spurious.

source_forms.proposed_remedy: phonology-independent grammar complexity / Minimum Description Length-style pruning

normalized_environment: LATE_LEARNED != automatically ACCIDENTAL; known grammar still acquired as late as constraint-selection step 56
exceptions_or_counterexamples: The mostly redundant Table 17 constraint #2 is explicitly ignored in the authors' count.

time_scope: Dixon 1981 corpus as modeled by Hayes & Wilson
claim: Twelve of the puzzling learned Wargamay constraints refer to secondary-stressed vowels ([+stress,-main]). Hayes & Wilson explicitly suspect that segmental-sequencing constraints of that nonhierarchical stress-specific type are phonologically impossible and argue that stress effects on sequencing should instead be represented hierarchically.

source_forms.authors_assessment: suspect no such constraints are possible in phonology

formal_environment: segmental sequencing conditioned specifically on SECONDARY_STRESS
normalized_environment: SECONDARY_STRESS_SPECIFIC segmental penalties flagged by source as likely theoretical overgeneration
exceptions_or_counterexamples: This is an authors' theoretical diagnosis of model output, not empirical evidence that Wargamay lacks every secondary-stress-conditioned segmental distribution.
